open_work: Two six-level fitted rack frames and their 36 original stock identities shift +0.20m along X to clear the fitted drawer-wall end. Hidden original source references keep their poses.

The local rack/tray timber key uses the existing original wood_dark shipping maps after native inspection found the coarse timber imagery distracting on small stock trays. Other source timber and shared maps retain their owners.
Original transaction counter keeps the capsule-purchasing anchor and upper datum. Stock remains passive visual fabrication; inventory, hours and saved-state authority remain.
Glass/tool racks, the deliberately missing tool, plot-device ladder and continuous shop/rear access remain open. Independent utility continuity and capacity are separate.

The east rack starts at x=5.62m to clear the closed back-door case by 40mm. Its far end remains x=9.10m; stock tray centres redistribute linearly within that span without changing tray size, row heights or inventory.
